reviews.classification: causal writing workflow, later world-correction authority and obsolete milestone
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers157input lines, F1–F5/R1–R5, the entire original Grey Weir demonstration/D1–D4, inputs/role/source/continuity rubric and W1–W5/OD8/detail-review addenda. Oversized combined output was recovered with complete tail reading before full credit. USER_VISION3661–3698explicitly records OD7/OD8: natural course unless changed, authored plots/simulation by mode, truth/knowledge/view separate and actual world correction mechanisms possible. The narrative guide restates those ideas; its workflow/rubric/sample scene remains proposed. It selects no permanent worker, AI provider, runtime generator, new world or infinite simulation.

F2: Preserve one finite premise/current-situation unit, actor competence/resources/private aims/non-player ties, observed source voice versus original examples, information channel and actual state-consumer intent. Literal-self premise does not authorize invented biography or outside expertise. The demonstration is wholly authored public content, not a selected world/source law or a hidden designer truth. Controlled experiment/quiet employment/cooperation/departure are compatible alternatives, contingent on real tools, knowledge, agreement and funds, rather than mandatory catastrophe or loyalty grind. Prose can describe intended consequence without implementing body/stock/knowledge/permission.

F3: W1baseline, W2disturbance, W3propagation, W4playablebeat and W5aftermath keep occurrence/discovery, attempt/result, source/counterfactual and observer/author truth distinct. When a necessary cause disappears, its dependent beat changes; independent plans continue. OD8’s later correction makes world-supported fate/heavenlywill restoration possible with actual reach/cost/means, not a blanket ban on replacement or a universal self-correcting canon. Repeatability remains chance/means-qualified. Selected clocks do not advance because chat is silent or a browser is closed.

F4: Save exact premise/revision, material commitments, participants, knowledge channels, superseded history and next eligible situation in existing world/timeline owners; a synopsis alone cannot rewrite a promise. Avoid a duplicate universal lore/event registry or compulsory five-role hierarchy. Rubric0–2and a proposed first unit are comparison aids, not product approval or extra universal gates. Current PROJECT retires the old one-realm/prestige line; canon-first/current selected sequence remains. Human taste review is optional under AD42, with actual world selection and implementation authority separate. No new writing assignment, worker, source reading/acquisition, gameplay/build/browser/save or human acceptance proof occurs.
reviews.evidence: All157lines read, recovered combined-output truncation; exact USER_VISION3661–3698direction and timeline1–15support scoped authority, no raw source/world build.
reviews.reopen: Selected authoring can use existing W1–W5/world owner, with source/current causality and actual effects; proposals alone authorize no runtime.

reviews.classification: historical implementation proposals, actual receipt/store semantics and shared-design scope
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers180input lines, all70coded rows: IMC1–12, IMS1–11, IMJ1–8, IMA1–8, IMV1–7, IMB1–7, IMR1–6, IMX1–6 and IMD1–5, with every prose hazard/compatibility/architecture/fixture/performance/ownership/optional-choice paragraph. Initial combined and later tail truncation was recovered in bounded complete ranges. All code locators/bundle/save-fixture bytes/lane reservations and measured facts are the October14dirty-tree snapshot, not current implementation, live workers or new test/performance proof. The historical external-storage reference is not current device/browser quota authority; no browser/personal-save/source-fixture access occurs here.

F2: Current selected source371–386still deduplicates relationship delivery by cause+actor+target+axis while trimming recent memories to32; same-axis components under one cause need intended aggregation/versioned component receipt, while a genuinely later occurrence can have a new cause. That receipt map is not a universal event log. Current save_files239–270still has4MiBapplication budget, UTF8and estimatedUTF16measurements and other-key accounting; this is selected source evidence, not an executed quota/loader/rollback test. File bytes, decoded data, origin occupancy, backup/dev keys, saved truth and rendered projections differ. Old fixture/bundle timings cannot supply current p95, long-campaign distribution or a fresh native journey.

F3: Preserve directed bond, actual received report, region/institution audience, value judgement, condition, source-specific corruption, current body chronology, residence right, inventory and explicit accepted obligation as distinct facts. Logs/cursors/rendered lines do not create remembered contact, claim truth, actual stock or agreement. Compaction must preserve reader-needed unsettled terms and replay identity; memory eviction alone cannot erase obligations or permit duplicate delivery. Borrowed source meanings and existing legacy semantics need an explicit selected compatibility policy, with AR6’s recorded reset/drop option distinct from round-tripping new state. The eleven optional schema/store sketches are proposals, not a requirement to build competing owners.

F4: Shared abstraction no longer waits for two implemented consumers: AD51/AR12allow reasonable whole-known-source design, and AR11uses a different second case to validate/revise the seam. Retire IMJ8’s implicit two-consumer prerequisite. One selected reader can reuse a thin existing owner; no rewrite, TS/ECS/backend/event-bus conversion or full social platform is required. Age/body/appearance eligibility remains the owning direction; cosmetic labels/unknown chronology do not invent permission, and ordinary friendship/care remain useful. Frozen absence, active idle, offline and local elapsed contact need their actual policies and cannot share one inferred wall clock.

F5: Byte/cast/line/time/row targets in IMB and IMS are explicitly engineering review proposals, not measured success, fixed friend/discovery caps or new import rejection rules. Admission/quote/revalidation, resource settlement, durable publish and observer-safe projection need the actual selected consumers. Optional signal failure cannot undo an earned lesson; source/differential/clock/interruption/import/quota scenarios remain useful when relevant, not a universal expansion of every task’s test gates. IMDfile/API/test names and SSB1/2→3ordering are historical proposals; current PROJECT governs work and ownership. Dated lane/process records grant no live reservation or mandatory permission exchange today.

F6: IMX1already maps OA18to accepted occurrences; OA23already qualifies cause descriptors. OA19’s one-cause-log shorthand and OA22’s one-claim-object shorthand are narrowed in their existing owner: audience-qualified delivered accounts can share causal IDs without making economic unique claims a universal news store. Keep part32navigation and part40implementation proposals linked, without duplicating rules or selecting new runtime. Retire old one-realm milestone and make human fiction review optional under AD42, without changing the fixed body-age content boundary. Source-edit/focusedcheck/build/earneddesktop/persistence/human stages remain separate. No runtime implementation, source acquisition, worker, new test/build/browser/save, schema migration, deletion/move, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: All180lines/70rows read in bounded ranges including recovered tail. Current selected effect and save-budget code read, not broad runtime validation.
reviews.reopen: Inspect actual producer/state/consumer and selected compatibility before any authorized implementation; retain source/test/browser/persistence proof scopes.

folds.heading: ## Implementation-palette scope reconciliation B614
folds.body: The [implementation palette](40_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSIDERATIONS.md#content-reconciliation-b614-historical-seams-and-current-owner-boundaries) is fully reviewed across all70IMrows. Keep logs as projections, actual completed occurrence/replay identity as the relevant supplier, and audience-qualified delivered knowledge separate from unique economic claims. A later genuine act can count without duplicating the same cause. Current selected source still shows32recent relationship memories plus longer cause receipts; trimming the former does not prove safe deletion of the latter or of unsettled reader-needed terms. Historical byte/workload goals and SSBfile sketches remain proposals, not runtime proof/current dispatch. AD51permits a reasonable shared design before a second case validates it; current PROJECT retires the old milestone, and human fiction review is optional under AD42.

folds.heading: ## Shared occurrence and report-owner reconciliation B614
folds.body: The [part40review](40_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSIDERATIONS.md#content-reconciliation-b614-historical-seams-and-current-owner-boundaries) qualifies OA19/OA22alongside existing OA18/OA23corrections. Shared causal identifiers need not be a universal occurrence database, and a settled unique reward claim is not a rumor/news report. Preserve actual producer, recipient delivery, attribution/basis/correction and affected reader; audience judgement can disagree with author truth. Current selected source cause receipts deduplicate relationship delivery, with recent memories separately bounded. Useful shared descriptors are proposed where needed under AD51/AR11/AR12, rather than new mandatory schemas or two-consumer-before-design gates.
